neighbours.label: the modifier slot in an evaluative 'X is / became / remains a [adj] ___' frame that anticipates an acclaim noun (wonder, marvel, sensation, phenomenon, classic, tradition, gem); the same adjectives in plain descriptive frames do not fire
fire: Seen from the ridge at sunset, the valley is nothing short of a scenic masterpiece.
With four straight titles, the team has turned into a sporting dynasty.
Her cookbook quickly became a national sensation and sold out in a week.
Over the decades the little diner has grown into a local institution, beloved by three generations.
Thanks to the film, the beach has become a global tourist magnet.
His debut album remains an undisputed classic of the genre.
The fireworks over the harbour have become an annual spectacle that draws huge crowds.
For fans of old cinemas, the restored theatre is an architectural gem.
quiet: Seen from the ridge at sunset, the valley has a scenic road running along its floor.
With four buses a day, the team travels to a sporting venue in the next town.

The little diner hires a local plumber whenever the pipes freeze.
